task.brief: Plan my working week of May 10-14, 2027 with 20 hours of deep work. I have family commitments; ask me about my work hours, protected times, privacy rules and the coordination checkpoint before scheduling around them. Read the incoming CEO request and prepare a reply draft, but never send replies or accept external meetings for me. Wait for the review's final published time, then show me the exact plan and apply it to my private calendar only after I approve.
